    Module-owned info.json semantics for UltraHDR gain-map tiles (UltraHdrTileSink.HDR_PROFILE_URI).
    UltraHdrAssembler
    Reassembles a served UltraHDR (gain-map) IIIF endpoint into a single full-resolution UltraHDR JPEG.
    UltraHdrAssembler.Region
    Parsed {x},{y},{w},{h} region from a IIIF tile URL.
    UltraHdrException
    Thrown when an ultrahdr WASM function returns an error string, or the module fails to load or execute.
    UltraHdrImageSource
    An ImageSource for UltraHDR JPEGs: the primary (SDR) image is decoded through the regular ImageIO pipeline, while the gain map and its ISO 21496-1 metadata are split out via the ultrahdr WASM codec and exposed through the HdrSource capability (see HdrFrame.gainmap()).
    UltraHdrTileSink
    A TileSink decorator that integrates the UltraHDR gain map into every tile: the delegate sink renders the primary tile, the gain map for the tile region is cropped from the HdrFrame the Tiler attaches through the metadata map (see HdrFrame.META_FRAME), re-encoded, and the ultrahdr WASM codec assembles both into an UltraHDR JPEG that is written to the real output stream.
    UltraHdrWasm
    Low-level binding to the ultrahdr_wasm WASM module.
